BVNK is the stablecoin-powered financial stack for enterprises. We're now part of Mastercard, and together we're building a network for every form of money – one that delivers more reach, more capability and more choice.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Global Direct Procurement (all genders)
jobs.description:
The role

HelloFresh manages approximately €1.7B in annual direct procurement spend across ingredients and packaging, covering markets in the EU, US, Canada, ANZ, and the UK. This role builds the cost intelligence capability for Global Procurement. You will create the analytical models and frameworks that give the business clear visibility into what ingredients really cost: where those costs come from, how they move, and where the opportunities lie. Your work will give regional teams the insight they need to make well-grounded decisions and to track progress against the group's cost reduction ambitions. This is a role for a senior procurement professional who is comfortable with detailed analysis and who can explain complex numbers simply to senior leaders and to colleagues in markets. You will be recognised as the go-to expert on cost across the team.

 

You will...

  • Develop a harmonised cost measurement methodology with Finance and regional procurement teams, so that ingredient savings are defined, measured, and reported consistently across all markets.
  • Build should-cost models and total cost of ownership frameworks for priority categories, breaking unit price into its drivers (origin, processing method, logistics, certification, and shelf life), and use them to identify savings and inform sourcing decisions.
  • Track ingredient price drivers across markets, including contract prices

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Global Direct Procurement
jobs.description:
The role

HelloFresh manages approximately €1.7B in annual direct procurement spend across ingredients and packaging, covering markets in the EU, US, Canada, ANZ, and the UK. This role builds the cost intelligence capability for Global Procurement. You will create the analytical models and frameworks that give the business clear visibility into what ingredients really cost: where those costs come from, how they move, and where the opportunities lie. Your work will give regional teams the insight they need to make well-grounded decisions and to track progress against the group's cost reduction ambitions. This is a role for a senior procurement professional who is comfortable with detailed analysis and who can explain complex numbers simply to senior leaders and to colleagues in markets. You will be recognised as the go-to expert on cost across the team.

 

You will...

  • Develop a harmonised cost measurement methodology with Finance and regional procurement teams, so that ingredient savings are defined, measured, and reported consistently across all markets.
  • Build should-cost models and total cost of ownership frameworks for priority categories, breaking unit price into its drivers (origin, processing method, logistics, certification, and shelf life), and use them to identify savings and inform sourcing decisions.
  • Track ingredient price drivers across markets, including contract prices

jobs.title: Stage Consumentengedrag
jobs.description: Waarom pak je in de supermarkt het ene product wel uit het schap en het andere niet? Ligt het aan de verpakking? De prijs? Smaak? Gemak? jobs.title: IT Operations Engineer
jobs.description:
At IMC, technology is not a department; it’s at the heart of everything we do. Developed in-house, our innovative software makes millions of trading decisions daily, and we win by making better and faster decisions than our competition. Our on-site IT Support team helps us move at a higher pace and quality each day, from hands-on support for end users to configuring and automating our systems to scale our support capabilities.

In this fully on-site position, you are the first person people come to with any IT issue, whether it’s a MacBook, a SaaS application, identity and access management, or hardware and AV. You support our growing Zug office and act as first- to third-line support. Our environment is predominantly macOS and cloud-based, with a small Windows footprint. You’ll work across a wide range of SaaS and custom systems. To succeed and grow, you take ownership, work autonomously, and keep improving an IT environment that runs smoothly and is ready to scale. 

Your Responsibilities:

  • First-to-third line support for our users, mainly on macOS.
  • Managing and supporting our end-user platform, including Microsoft 365, Okta (SSO, MFA, lifecycle management), Slack and the Atlassian stack (Jira, Confluence, Jira Service Management).
  • Device management and patching: Jamf for macOS and Intune for phones, including enrollment, configuration profiles, app deployment and compliance.

Reporting directly to the VP Technology, you'll build new capability for Awin with AI at the core, free from the constraints of our established delivery model. You'll take ideas from concept to production quickly, prove what works, and turn the best of it into patterns the wider engineering organisation can adopt.

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient,

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. jobs.title: Stagiair Journalistiek - Trouw
jobs.description: Wil je graag snel aan de slag in de journalistiek? Dan is deze stage op de redactie bij Trouw iets voor jou. Trouw bereikt dagelijks duizenden betrokken mensen met de verdiepende journalistiek via print en online via de nieuwssite, nieuwsapps en digitale krant. Doordeweeks gaat het om 316.000 lezers via print en op zaterdag om ruim 430.000 lezers via krant en magazine. Daarnaast bereikt Trouw ook nog eens 2,3 miljoen unieke digitale lezers per maand via web en app. Kom bij ons stagelopen en zie je eigen ideeën, verhalen en producties terug in print, op onze site of social media. Wat ga je doen Stagiair zijn bij Trouw betekent hard werken, maar ook zelfstandig meedraaien, veel schrijven en op pad gaan, meewerken aan de online promotie van je verhalen en je ontwikkelen als volwaardig lid van een redactie. Stages zijn mogelijk bij nieuwsredacties verslaggeverij/binnenland, buitenland/nieuwsdienst, sport en politiek maar ook bij de redacties religie & filosofie en duurzaamheid & economie. Trouw zorgt daarbij voor deskundige en intensieve begeleiding. Voor goede stagiaires zijn er ook na de stage ook mogelijkheden voor werk.
